info.title: Library Service API
info.description: Strict JSON; versioned REST; PostgreSQL-backed authorization and atomic interactions. Collection search uses case-insensitive literal substrings. JSON null in PATCH means unchanged. Unknown request fields are rejected.

400.description: Malformed JSON, unknown request field, or multiple JSON values.

403.description: Wrong role, ownership denied, disallowed origin, or blocked account.

422.description: Field validation or query parameter failure.

500.description: Unexpected error; internal details are never exposed.
